research_findings: Discovered missing rate-limit implementation in waitlist action (joinWaitlist).
Identified that server actions can be hit repeatedly without mitigation, exposing the DB to bot spam.
Researched Next.js 15+ headers resolution and in-memory Map strategies for simple server-side limiting with periodic garbage collection via interval.unref().
features_improved: Waitlist signup endpoint (joinWaitlist) secured against automated spam with an in-memory RateLimiter.
new_features_added: Reusable server-side in-memory RateLimiter utility with auto-cleanup.
next_steps_for_next_run: Expand rate limiting to other sensitive unauthenticated server actions (e.g. magic link emails).
Investigate upgrading to Redis-backed distributed rate limiting for multi-region deployments.
